bytetrack.review_box_method: Prior visually inspected tan-coat boxes, ID16 before frame287 and ID35 afterward; overlap>=0.5 for diagnostics. Not ground-truth trajectories.

tracktrack.review_box_method: Prior visually inspected tan-coat boxes, ID16 before frame287 and ID35 afterward; overlap>=0.5 for diagnostics. Not ground-truth trajectories.

tracktrack-reid.review_box_method: Prior visually inspected tan-coat boxes, ID16 before frame287 and ID35 afterward; overlap>=0.5 for diagnostics. Not ground-truth trajectories.

qualitative_findings: AI visual review of the same source crops supports following the tan-coat person across this local segment. Existing prior boxes locate the review target; they are not ground-truth identity annotations.

ByteTrack: ID16 covers the coat region through frame286; overlapping detections receive ID16 and ID35 at frames287-291; only ID35 remains from frame292 through360 in this diagnostic segment. The larger overlapping box also reaches toward the nearby purple-shirt person.

TrackTrack OFF and ON: ID12 is present through frame290, no coat-overlap detection has an ID at frames291-293 (3 frames, 0.125 s), and ID12 is restored at frame294. Later border-truncated frames352-354 and360 are also unassigned.
This is a local ID recovery with a coverage gap, not uninterrupted tracking. The same duplicate raw detections remain in all cached outputs.
ReID ON and OFF produce identical per-detection ID assignments over both full clips (602 source frames); this test supplies no observed additional identity or count benefit from ReID.
Distinct assigned IDs are not a person count. The reduction22->18 cannot establish global fragmentation improvement; no trajectory ground truth is available.

This compares the installed Ultralytics TrackTrack implementation on the fixed detector pool, not complete reproduction of the TrackTrack paper. The ReID implementation uses its native default224 crop; the ONNX input is dynamic, FP32, CUDAExecutionProvider active.

detector_spot_checks.method: Two post-review source frames, selected before examining these detector outputs. This is a localized qualitative check, not a detection benchmark or a full-frame recall estimate.
